findingDetails.title: A plain question about the loop still serves /deep:review when its auxiliary or its "how long" shape is outside the question grammar
findingDetails.scopeProof: The gate is inside the declared review target and listed in review-scope-files.txt; the finding cites both copies and the executed calls that produce the false offer.
findingDetails.claim: A question about the loop whose auxiliary or shape is outside the question grammar opens the deep-loop command gate in both copies.
findingDetails.counterevidenceSought: Checked whether the broad naming rule in spec.md section 2 makes the prompt an ask by definition, and whether the ask policy limits the damage; the broad rule covers it literally and the policy prevents spend, but REQ-016 is general and the purpose says the offer appears only for a loop request.
findingDetails.alternativeExplanation: The auxiliary list is deliberately finite and REQ-016 names only two examples, so a how-long question is an accepted false offer.
findingDetails.downgradeTrigger: If REQ-016 two examples are read as the exhaustive check, this becomes P2 hardening.

results.summary: REQ-011 clean; REQ-016 contradicted by R1-P1-001; 57 REQs remain for iteration 4.

noveltyJustification: One new P1 on a branch no fixture row covers; the 368-case fixture and 72 hand-built prompts produced no other new signal.
